[P2] Cover unusable deadline values in the AI wrapper

The added deadline tests cover finite readings and a throwing reader, but none returns NaN, Infinity, or a non-number. Removing this guard therefore leaves their assertions unchanged, although unusable readings would reach `AbortSignal.timeout` and could fail an otherwise valid operation. The core deadline contract tests do not exercise this separate helper. Under CONTRIBUTING rule 4, return to the testing design and require successful AI calls with unusable readings, asserting that only the step cancellation signal remains.
